title: Denoising autoencoder

paper.title: Extracting and Composing Robust Features with Denoising Autoencoders

related.title: Extracting and Composing Robust Features with Denoising Autoencoders (author-hosted PDF)

paper.year_note: Original/preprint year except GCN (2017 venue, 2016 preprint) and speculative decoding (2023 venue, 2022 preprint).

statement: Implement Denoising autoencoder: reconstruct clean MNIST from corrupted inputs under a bottleneck parameter budget. Read the linked paper and isolate the named mechanism. Write a self-contained solve(data), fit using training tensors only, and return Submission(model=model). Keep validation labels out of fitting and preprocessing. This is an educational reduced-scale adaptation, not a claim to reproduce original paper results. Use mnist; required output: [N,1,28,28] -> [N,1,28,28] reconstruction. Evaluate mse (minimize). Train on corrupted clean pairs; metric against clean pixels; fixed 16-unit bottleneck. Required ablation: Train without corruption; compare reconstruction at equal bottleneck width.

dataset.name: mnist
dataset.description: Train on corrupted clean pairs; metric against clean pixels; fixed 16-unit bottleneck
dataset.split_policy: Disjoint train/validation/test examples; fit preprocessing using training data only.
dataset.evaluation: Apply fixed seeded corruption; compare reconstruction with clean input, not digit labels.

ablation.change: Train without corruption; compare reconstruction at equal bottleneck width
